lines: In the Wild West, there was a cowboy who once arrested the town sheriff.
And the funniest part?
Nobody believed him.
One morning, Jack rode into a dusty little town and noticed something strange.
Every bank in town had been robbed,
but the sheriff somehow knew exactly when each robbery would happen.
Jack became suspicious.
So he spent three nights watching the sheriff's office.
And on the fourth night,
he saw something unbelievable.
The sheriff quietly walked into the bank,
opened the vault,
and started filling his bags with gold.
Jack immediately pulled out his revolver.
"Hands up, Sheriff!"
The sheriff froze.
Then he slowly turned around and said...
"You're under arrest, cowboy."
Turns out, the sheriff had already reported Jack as the town's most wanted criminal.
And since nobody had ever seen the real sheriff outside his office...
The entire town believed Jack was the robber.
But Jack had one final trick.
He pulled out the sheriff's own wanted poster...
Which showed the sheriff's face.
And suddenly, the whole town realised...
Their sheriff was the criminal all along.
